title: API Versioning with Router
prompt:
You are a web developer. Complete the following task.

TASK: Build an Express.js application with API versioning using `Express.Router`. Implement GET `/api/v1/users`, GET `/api/v2/users`, POST `/api/v2/users`, and GET `/api/version`. V1 returns users with only `name`. V2 returns `name`, `email`, and `createdAt`, plus a `meta` object. Both versions share the same in-memory user store.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Use Express.js and `Express.Router`
- Share a single in-memory user store between versions
- Keep v1 read-only
- Export the app with `module.exports = app`

IMPORTANT:
- Return ONLY the code. No explanations.
- Output a single complete file.
- Do not use markdown code blocks.
constraints: Share a single in-memory user store between versions
